{{Quote|Candoras is far from the mainstream of Imperial life and commerce, with a sector fleet consisting of four antiquated Dreadnoughts and some smaller ships, and limited resources of all sorts.|[[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="CoO" />}}
The '''Candoras sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], located near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==History==
{{Quote|Governor Ferrouz is offering a very intriguing deal: a full-fledged base for the Alliance, complete with logistical support, docking facilities, and one of the finest natural supply depots in the galaxy...|[[Vestin Axlon]]|<ref name="CoO" />}}
Located near [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the area that would become the Candoras sector was considered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a bulwark against potential threats from both those areas.<ref name="CoO" /> The Candoras sector was a [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsector]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]],<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 4.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-10-22}}</ref> meaning that its boundaries were charted and the sector was formally established sometimes after the reorganization of the regular [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sectors subsequent to the [[Declaration of a New Order]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was overseen by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] and defended by the [[Ferrouz's sector fleet|Candoras Sector Fleet]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Ferrouz contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to offer the Rebellion a base in the sector.<ref name="CoO" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated that the Candoras sector and other sectors listed within brackets in the ''Atlas'' appendix were freestanding subsectors.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_4.jpg|author=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-10-22}}</ref>
